name: High Elf
reviewNotes: Fey Teleportation enhancement approved: the inherited Misty Step free casting now recharges on a Short or Long Rest. Its level-5 unlock, once-per-recharge limit, independent pool and slot casting remain unchanged.
No biological language entitlement from Fey Teleportation; Sylvan language belongs to a separately reviewed Upbringing choice. Elven Accuracy is not granted.
The open Wizard cantrip spell-list selection still requires its separate authorized selection/projection workstream.
